notes: As printed classical: Cauchy p = integral of width, width >= max(w, d|cos t|), so p >= 2 sqrt(d^2-w^2) + 2w arcsin(w/d), equality for the hull of a disk of diameter w and the ends of a diameter-d segment through its centre; no polygon attains it, so the conjectured extremals (polygons in a Reuleaux triangle) are wrong. Bieri's original wording (Gruber-Schneider in [TW] p. 256) not consulted; the scan text has only the CFG paragraph. No Lean: Mathlib lacks Cauchy's formula and width functions. Outside Lean: the whole argument.
